changelog.change: The first plan: conversations.conversation_archived and conversations.conversation_unarchived, with a conversations.conversation snapshot (the reference flow of ADR 0020).

The conversations module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#325): 40 events for flags, streams, labels, needs, drafts and sends, taught rules and their runs, suggestions, person notes, provider batches, the model pass, Scout's reads and inboxes; records draft, need, rule and rule_run; Coverage for every operation, job, schedule and handler of the module.

The identity module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#326): 27 events for sign-ins succeeded and refused, accounts created, sessions ended, ways in and passkeys added and removed, suspensions, workspace and registered apps, consents, held mailbox grants, and token exchanges, reuse and revocation; records account, session, way_in, passkey, client and consent; Coverage for every operation, handler and schedule of the module.

The web BFF instrumented (campbooks-cloud#327): 3 events for web sessions started, ended one at a time (logging out, signing in again, a copied cookie, outdated scopes, a refused refresh, unreadable tokens, an expired access token) and ended at once (back-channel logout, signing out everywhere, a suspension); the enums of how they end; Coverage for every operation, handler and schedule of the BFF. bff is a platform module, generated into the kernel and tracked from the server.

The workspaces module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#328): 16 events for workspaces created, updated, deleted and purged, members joined, role changed, left, suspended and unsuspended, invitations created, signup requests filed, approved and rejected, and signup codes minted, revoked and redeemed; records workspace, member, invitation, signup_request and signup_code; Coverage for every operation, handler and job of the module; the conversations and identity exemptions name workspaces.workspace_deleted.

The connectors module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#329): 10 events for connections added, reconnected, removed, their health changed and a sync asked for, sync runs (one summary per run, with counts), the outbound changes a run made (counts by end), calendar changes completed, and sends succeeded or failed; records connection, stream and send; Coverage for every operation, job, schedule and handler of the module; the identity operations that hand it a grant name the connection events.

The assistant, attention, search and system modules instrumented (campbooks-cloud#330): 15 events for chats with Scout started, continued, answered and deleted, its proposals confirmed, declined and undone, a member's profile updated, an item snoozed and unsnoozed, a workspace's daily AI limit reached, and (the kernel's queue, from the system admin actions) a dead job retried or discarded, a kind's dead jobs retried and a schedule's stuck run discarded; records chat, answer, proposal, profile, item and job; Coverage for every operation, job, schedule and handler of the four modules (search and the telemetry reports exempt).

accepted_by.description: Who accepted it: their user id.

role.description: The role the invitee gets on accepting (admin or member).

invitation.title: workspaces.invitation

suspended.description: Whether their account is suspended, as this module last announced it.

schema.title: workspaces.member_joined

events.description: A person stopped being a member: they left, or a manager removed them. The snapshot is the membership as it stood when it ended.
events.fires_when: workspaces.leave, or workspaces.remove_member (on oneself it is leaving), deletes the membership, in the transaction that publishes workspaces.member_left.
events.name: workspaces.member_left

schema.description: A person stopped being a member: they left, or a manager removed them. The snapshot is the membership as it stood when it ended.

how.description: Whether they left or were removed.

mail.description: What becomes of the mail of the mailboxes they connected.

member.description: The membership as it stood when it ended.

suspended.description: Whether their account is suspended, as this module last announced it.

member.title: workspaces.member

schema.title: workspaces.member_left

events.description: A member's role changed. The snapshot is the member afterwards; before is the role they had.
events.fires_when: workspaces.change_role gives a member another role; giving the role they have tracks nothing.
events.name: workspaces.member_role_changed

schema.description: A member's role changed. The snapshot is the member afterwards; before is the role they had.

member.description: The member with their new role.

suspended.description: Whether their account is suspended, as this module last announced it.

member.title: workspaces.member

schema.title: workspaces.member_role_changed

events.description: A member's account was suspended: whatever acts in their name in the workspace stops until it is lifted. Tracked in each workspace they belong to.
events.fires_when: workspaces.announce_member_suspended announces identity.account_suspended in the workspace, in the transaction that publishes workspaces.member_suspended there; a change that leaves them as they were (a replay, an older change, a second suspension with no lift between) tracks nothing.
events.name: workspaces.member_suspended

schema.description: A member's account was suspended: whatever acts in their name in the workspace stops until it is lifted. Tracked in each workspace they belong to.

suspended.description: Whether their account is suspended, as this module last announced it.

schema.title: workspaces.member_suspended

events.description: A member's suspension was lifted. Tracked in each workspace they belong to.
events.fires_when: workspaces.announce_member_unsuspended announces identity.account_unsuspended in the workspace, likewise; a lift that leaves them as they were (a replay, an older change) tracks nothing.
events.name: workspaces.member_unsuspended

schema.description: A member's suspension was lifted. Tracked in each workspace they belong to.

suspended.description: Whether their account is suspended, as this module last announced it.

schema.title: workspaces.member_unsuspended

events.description: An administrator minted a signup code. The code and its label never appear.
events.fires_when: workspaces.admin_mint_signup_code stores it.
events.name: workspaces.signup_code_minted

schema.description: An administrator minted a signup code. The code and its label never appear.

signup_code.description: The new code, without the code itself or its label.

expires_at.description: After this it cannot be redeemed.

max_uses.description: How many times it can be redeemed.

signup_code.title: workspaces.signup_code

schema.title: workspaces.signup_code_minted

events.description: A use of a minted signup code was spent creating a workspace: the event belongs to the workspace it opened.
events.fires_when: workspaces.create spends the code, in the transaction that creates the workspace. A code from the instance's configuration is not a minted one and tracks nothing.
events.name: workspaces.signup_code_redeemed

schema.description: A use of a minted signup code was spent creating a workspace: the event belongs to the workspace it opened.

signup_code.description: The code after the use was spent.

expires_at.description: After this it cannot be redeemed.

max_uses.description: How many times it can be redeemed.

signup_code.title: workspaces.signup_code

schema.title: workspaces.signup_code_redeemed

events.description: An administrator revoked a signup code: it can no longer be redeemed.
events.fires_when: workspaces.admin_revoke_signup_code revokes a code that was not revoked; a retry tracks nothing.
events.name: workspaces.signup_code_revoked

schema.description: An administrator revoked a signup code: it can no longer be redeemed.

expires_at.description: After this it cannot be redeemed.

max_uses.description: How many times it can be redeemed.

schema.title: workspaces.signup_code_revoked

events.description: An administrator approved a signup request: the person may create a workspace.
events.fires_when: workspaces.admin_approve_signup_request approves a request that was not approved; a retry tracks nothing.
events.name: workspaces.signup_request_approved

schema.description: An administrator approved a signup request: the person may create a workspace.

status.description: Where it stands.

user_id.description: The requesting user (also the request's id).

with_reason.description: Whether the administrator gave a reason (never the reason).

schema.title: workspaces.signup_request_approved

events.description: A person with no workspace asked to create one on an instance whose signup needs approval.
events.fires_when: workspaces.create under the approval policy files the person's first request; asking again tracks nothing.
events.name: workspaces.signup_request_filed

schema.description: A person with no workspace asked to create one on an instance whose signup needs approval.

status.description: Where it stands.

user_id.description: The requesting user (also the request's id).

with_reason.description: Whether the administrator gave a reason (never the reason).

schema.title: workspaces.signup_request_filed

events.description: An administrator turned a signup request down. Whether they gave a reason is kept, never the reason.
events.fires_when: workspaces.admin_reject_signup_request rejects a request that was not rejected; a retry tracks nothing.
events.name: workspaces.signup_request_rejected

schema.description: An administrator turned a signup request down. Whether they gave a reason is kept, never the reason.

status.description: Where it stands.

user_id.description: The requesting user (also the request's id).

with_reason.description: Whether the administrator gave a reason (never the reason).

schema.title: workspaces.signup_request_rejected

events.description: A workspace was created; its creator is its first owner. The snapshot is the new workspace, never its name.
events.fires_when: workspaces.create creates it, in the transaction that inserts it (with the owner's member_joined).
events.name: workspaces.workspace_created

schema.description: A workspace was created; its creator is its first owner. The snapshot is the new workspace, never its name.

deleted_at.description: When it was deleted, if it was.

purge_after.description: When a deleted workspace's records are purged.

schema.title: workspaces.workspace_created

events.description: A workspace was deleted: hidden at once, every module purges its data, and its own records are purged after the grace period. The snapshot carries when it was deleted and when it is purged.
events.fires_when: workspaces.delete deletes it, in the transaction that publishes workspaces.workspace_deleting and schedules the purge.
events.name: workspaces.workspace_deleted

schema.description: A workspace was deleted: hidden at once, every module purges its data, and its own records are purged after the grace period. The snapshot carries when it was deleted and when it is purged.

deleted_at.description: When it was deleted, if it was.

purge_after.description: When a deleted workspace's records are purged.

schema.title: workspaces.workspace_deleted

events.description: A deleted workspace's records were hard-deleted at the end of its grace period. The snapshot is the workspace as it stood when purged.
events.fires_when: The workspaces.purge_workspace job deletes the workspace's row, in that transaction; a workspace purged already, or no longer deleted, tracks nothing.
events.name: workspaces.workspace_purged

schema.description: A deleted workspace's records were hard-deleted at the end of its grace period. The snapshot is the workspace as it stood when purged.

workspace_snapshot.description: The workspace as it stood when purged.

deleted_at.description: When it was deleted, if it was.

purge_after.description: When a deleted workspace's records are purged.

workspace_snapshot.title: workspaces.workspace

schema.title: workspaces.workspace_purged

events.description: A workspace's settings changed: which ones, never their values (the accent is an enum and is in the snapshot).
events.fires_when: workspaces.update changes its name or its accent; the values it already has track nothing.
events.name: workspaces.workspace_updated

schema.description: A workspace's settings changed: which ones, never their values (the accent is an enum and is in the snapshot).

deleted_at.description: When it was deleted, if it was.

purge_after.description: When a deleted workspace's records are purged.

schema.title: workspaces.workspace_updated
